task: عايز دراسه وتحسين الجرافيك وجعله افضل بكثير

findings.title: Generic animals (pig/cow/sheep) render eyes twice
findings.detail: The else branch for generic animals (line 2129) already renders a pair of eyes for pig/cow/sheep. Then lines 2147-2153 render a second pair for 'remaining mobs' which matches the same types. Each generic animal gets 4 eye boxes instead of 2. Remove the post-if/else 'Eyes for remaining mobs' block entirely.

findings.title: Spider renders 4 legs, not 8 as comment claims
findings.detail: Comment says 'Spider legs (8 total, 4 per side)' but the loop for(var leg=0;leg<4;leg++) only produces 4 legs total (2 per side). The spider is missing half its legs. Change loop to iterate 8 times.

findings.title: Particle color is hardcoded - per-particle BLOCK_RGB color is ignored
findings.detail: spawnParticles() stores per-particle r,g,b from BLOCK_RGB, but renderParticles() uses hardcoded gl.uniform4f(uColF,0.7,0.6,0.4,0.7) for all particles. Every block-break particle appears the same color regardless of block type.

findings.title: Star twinkle computed but never used in rendering
findings.detail: var twinkle=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(perfTime*2+si3*1.7) is computed per-star but never affects rendering. Stars render at constant opacity nightness2*0.7, so they don't twinkle.
